title: We need 25 to 30 g of fibre a day and most of us eat around 12. What does hitting it look like on Indian food?
text:
Fibermaxxing is everywhere right now, so I tried to work out what 25 to 30 g a day looks like with normal Indian food instead of imported stuff.

Rough numbers I used: a guava or a pear is 5 to 6 g. A tablespoon of chia is about 5 g. 100 g of whole urad dal is close to 20 g dry weight. Oats are about 10 g per 100 g. Rajma, chana and sprouts are all good too.

The food isn't the hard part. Eating it every single day with office lunches and late dinners is where I fall off.

What's your daily fibre source that actually sticks? And did anyone here go too fast and regret it? I've heard the bloating is real if you jump from 12 to 30 overnight.
